name: work-on-everything-rubric-evidence-hardening R-4 live criterion-ownership read
summary: Live stewardship rubric is active at revision 28 and every R-4 drift marker is not broken. At revision 26 marker (1) held: delegated-execution-and-drain-health's method still required a plan-scoped fleet for every started plan, contradicting its own rev21 ownership boundary. The re-read at revision 28 shows the duplicate is gone.
